Implemented and verified commit `1c0662b` on branch `codex/optimize-llama3-vllm-rmsnorm`.

Diagnosis: the largest baseline outlier was KV-cache append at 10.73x its R5 hardware limit; FlashInfer prefill was 7.33x. Their B200 alternatives were not warm-cache covered, so they were rejected under the no-GPU constraint. The achievable candidate was `unified.pre_attn.input_norm`: scalar `vllm_before` RMSNorm (`vec_size=1`, block cap 1024), whose exact `m=4096` leaf cost was 38.871717 us versus a 0.528515072 ms shared-location R5. `pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`.

Fix: [simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs:12) now uses the warm `vllm_after` recipe (`vec_size=8`, large block cap 256). Residual fused norms, attention, GEMMs, model dimensions, label, semantics, and the 14-leaf CostTree remain unchanged.

Evidence from the cache-only rerun `uv run python -m launcher timing-predict eval-configs/before.json` with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''`:

- RMSNorm leaf: 38.871717 us -> 17.605420 us, a derived 54.71% reduction; `pred.casev0.operationv0.kernel-throughput`.
- Shared `input_norm` location: 0.827308523 ms -> 0.806042226 ms; R5 remains 0.528515072 ms. The smaller scope reduction is expected because 31 untouched fused residual norms share this Analyzer location.
- Exact iteration total: 61.0077285767 ms -> 60.9864616394 ms. R5 remains 30.0001939353 ms, R6 remains 27.4336889243 ms, and R7 remains 27.3665669202 ms; `pred.overview`, `pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown`.
- Final CostTree has 14 slots and only the plain input_norm backend/config differs; `pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`.

Validation: 3 focused Rust tests passed and `git diff --check` passed. `cargo fmt --all --check` could not run because `cargo-fmt` is unavailable. The profile database timestamp and size are unchanged, and no GPU was used.

judge.reasoning: The agent identified the standalone scalar RMSNorm as the bottleneck and attributed it to unvectorized VEC_SIZE=1 execution. Its implemented switch to the vectorized VEC_SIZE=8 vLLM recipe with the reduced block cap has the same effect as the ground-truth fix while preserving the computation and leaving residual-fused norms unchanged.
